text:
The most likely ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis is **U07.1, COVID-19, virus identified**.

The diagnosis section is withheld, so this is inferred from the record. The patient was admitted and treated for COVID-19 after a positive diagnosis, and the summary describes the hospitalization as being for COVID-19 with supportive care. The chronic sinusitis, hyperglycemia, and hypoxia (72% saturation) would be coded as additional diagnoses. Coding a more specific pneumonia or respiratory condition would require documentation that the record does not contain.
